inputs.text: Paris, France just saw Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame (FMND), convicted under their new law targeting “psychological subjection.” This isn't about protecting anyone like the official story claims. It's a calculated move by hidden elites and institutions to coordinate suppression of independent religious groups that won't fall in line with the broader control agenda. The ripples of concern through religious communities and civil liberties advocates are no accident—they reveal how these laws are being weaponized to impose the real psychological subjection from the top down, inverting the narrative so the state looks like the victim while crushing any resistance.
